proof.text: Choose a trivializing cover member Ui through t(default), lift t to Ui using Mathlib exists_fac_of_etale_of_isSepClosed, and form the pullback W1 of U and Ui. Its pullback lift w1 retains the original marked lift v. Choose a set M and an isomorphism G.over Ui to the restriction of the constant sheaf M using Sheaf.mem_essImage_of_isConstant and the already proved CategoryTheory.constantSheafOverIso (WeilConjectures.Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Sites.ConstantSheafOver). Here G is the underlying set sheaf; no additive compatibility is required.

The sheafification unit of the constant presheaf is locally surjective (Mathlib W_toSheafify.isLocallySurjective). Apply Point.jointly_surjective to its image sieve twice, first to the image of a on W1 and then to the image of zero on the first refinement. This gives V with retained marked lift w3, constants m,z in M, and identities haV and hzV identifying the restrictions of a and zero with the constant sections m and z. Both identities follow by naturality of the chosen set-sheaf isomorphism and the sheafification unit.

The component of the sheaf isomorphism is injective. If m=z, haV and hzV force the restriction of a to V to equal zero. Point.toPresheafFiber_w transports this equality back to the marked germ at v, contradicting ha. Hence m differs from z. The marked lift w3 supplies an underlying point of V, so V is nonempty.

At any geometric lift to V, suppose the germ of the restriction of a is zero. Mathlib Point.toPresheafFiber_eq_iff' for AddCommGrpCat gives a further pointed neighbourhood W on which the section equals zero. Naturality of the set-sheaf chart and haV,hzV imply equality of the constant sections m,z on W. The sheafification unit is locally injective (W_toSheafify.isLocallyInjective), so Presheaf.equalizerSieve_mem is a covering sieve. Point.jointly_surjective at the retained lift to W provides an arrow in that sieve. The constant presheaf has identity restriction maps, so membership in that sieve says m=z, a contradiction. This avoids both constant-diagram colimit and constant-sheaf stalk computations.

title: Refinement to everywhere nonzero germs
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] and F an abelian sheaf on its small etale site [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves] with locally constant underlying set sheaf [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves]. Let U be an etale X-scheme, a a section of F on U, and v a lift to U of a geometric point t:Spec Ω→X with Ω algebraically closed. Assume the geometric germ of a at v [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks] is nonzero. There is a morphism r:V→U of etale X-schemes with V nonempty such that the germ of the restriction F(r)(a) is nonzero at every geometric lift to V.

lean.statement:
theorem refine_section_nonzero_germs (X : Scheme.{u})
    (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (hF : IsLocallyConstantEtaleSheafOfSets
      ((sheafCompose X.smallEtaleTopology (CategoryTheory.forget AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).obj F))
    (U : X.Etale) (a : F.obj.obj (op U))
    (Ω : Type u) [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω]
    (t : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ X) (v : (pointSmallEtale t).fiber.obj U)
    (ha : (pointSmallEtale t).toPresheafFiber U v F.obj a ≠ 0) :
    ∃ (V : X.Etale) (r : V ⟶ U), Nonempty V.left ∧
      ∀ (Ω' : Type u) [Field Ω'] [IsAlgClosed Ω']
        (t' : Spec (.of Ω') ⟶ X) (v' : (pointSmallEtale t').fiber.obj V),
        (pointSmallEtale t').toPresheafFiber V v' F.obj
          (F.obj.map r.op a) ≠ 0
